headline: Reddit’s AI is turning posts into podcasts and short videos
summary: Reddit is experimenting with AI to convert text posts into audio/video content. This initiative aims to offer new ways for users to consume content. AI voices read posts and comments to create short videos.

headline: ABC's livestreamed news show is powered by trending topics
summary: ABC News launched 'Searched,' a new livestreamed show. It focuses on trending social media topics and web searches. 'Searched' airs on ABC News Live, including Disney Plus.

headline: This compact Glorious mechanical keyboard is just $35
summary: The Glorious GMMK 3 mechanical keyboard is on sale for $34.99 at Woot. This 65-percent keyboard is a great entry point for keyboard enthusiasts. Use code WOOTGAMING for the discount; first-time Woot customers get an extra perk.

headline: Wordle meets Clippy in this new word game
summary: A new word game, Dartwords, combines elements of Wordle with Clippy. Created by game designer Sam Rosenthal from The Game Band. The game offers a fresh take on the daily word puzzle genre.

headline: The ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale
summary: The ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p portable USB monitor is currently on sale. It functions as an excellent secondary screen for laptops. Also ideal as a portable display for Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck.

headline: James Gunn Defends DCU's Tonal Shift
summary: James Gunn defended the DCU's shift in tone following the 'Lanterns' premiere. The DC Studios co-CEO clarified that the DCU will not have a single, uniform tone. 'Lanterns' generated buzz with its gritty first episode, sparking the discussion.

headline: Amazon's Game of Thrones T-Shirt Sale Features House of the Dragon Designs
summary: Amazon is hosting a sale on Game of Thrones t-shirts. The sale includes appealing designs inspired by 'House of the Dragon.' Fans can find various apparel options from the popular series.

headline: 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Drops to $1,198 on Amazon
summary: The 65-inch Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV is now priced at $1,198 on Amazon. This deal includes free shipping for buyers. The S90F was recognized as the best gaming TV in 2026.

headline: Trump Threatens Oman Over Iran Deal Involvement
summary: Donald Trump reportedly threatened to bomb US ally Oman. The threat is linked to Oman's involvement in Iran deal negotiations. Oman has been independently discussing reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

headline: Russia Warns UK Over Ukraine Drone Supplies
summary: Russia has issued a warning to the UK regarding its supply of drones to Ukraine. An MoD spokesperson reiterated Britain's commitment to supporting Ukraine. The UK maintains its stance of standing 'shoulder to shoulder' with Ukraine.

headline: Fifa Official Sacked After Criticizing Infantino
summary: Kevin Lamour, a senior Fifa figure, has been sacked. His dismissal follows criticism of Fifa president Gianni Infantino's plans. The sacking occurred three weeks after his public critique.

headline: BBC Details Trump's Policy Shift on North and South Korea
summary: Donald Trump announced plans to 'substantially reduce' joint US-South Korea military exercises. He cited his 'very good relationship' with Kim Jong Un as a reason for the shift. The BBC provides analysis on this latest development in US-Korean relations.
